bug_report_content: Joda - Time / Bugs / #148 DateTimeFormatter.parseInto broken when no year in format Join/Login Business Software Open Source Software For Vendors Blog About More Articles Create SourceForge Podcast Site Documentation Subscribe to our Newsletter Support Request DateTimeFormatter.parseInto broken when no year in format Project moved to GitHub Brought to you by: broneill , scolebourne This project can now be found here. Summary Files Reviews Support Code Svn Tickets ▾ Bugs Feature Requests News Discussion Donate Menu ▾ ▴ Create Ticket View Stats Group v1.0_(example) Searches Changes Closed Tickets Open Tickets Help Formatting Help #148 DateTimeFormatter.parseInto broken when no year in format Status: closed Owner: nobody Labels: Joda-Time (76) Priority: 5 Updated: 2012-10-08 Created: 2012-04-28 Creator: pipelare Private: No In Joda Time 2.0, the default year was set to 2000 so that Feb 29 could be parsed correctly. However, parseInto now overwrites the given instant's year with 2000 (or whatever iDefaultYear is set to). The correct behavior would seem to be to use the given instant's year instead of iDefaultYear. This does mean that Feb 29 might not be parseable if the instant's year is not a leap year, but in this case the caller asked for that in a sense.
